SQL:
WITH __slayer_stage_cr AS (
  SELECT
    _stage_inner."orders.customers.region_id" AS "customers__region_id",
    _stage_inner."orders.customer_id" AS "customer_id",
    _stage_inner."orders.rev" AS "rev"
  FROM (
    SELECT
      customers.region_id AS "orders.customers.region_id",
      orders.customer_id AS "orders.customer_id",
      CAST(SUM(orders.amount) AS DOUBLE) AS "orders.rev"
    FROM orders AS orders
    LEFT JOIN customers AS customers
      ON orders.customer_id = customers.id
    WHERE
      NOT customers.region_id IS NULL
    GROUP BY
      customers.region_id,
      orders.customer_id
  ) AS _stage_inner
)
SELECT
  cr.customers__region_id AS "cr.customers__region_id",
  cr.customer_id AS "cr.customer_id",
  cr.rev AS "cr.rev",
  CAST(SUM(cr.rev) AS DOUBLE) AS "cr.x"
FROM __slayer_stage_cr AS cr
GROUP BY
  cr.customers__region_id,
  cr.customer_id,
  cr.rev
LIMIT 21

args.message: In each region, the top customer accounts for between about 3.5% and 7% of the region's revenue. Revenue is the sum of all order amounts (every status counted), and customers with no region are left out. Region 5 (Arctic) has no customers with orders, so it doesn't appear. Each share is the customer's revenue divided by their region's total.
